takes.sourceDescription: B sits; A pulls up B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pull seated partner up, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A walks forward, bends and extends a hand downward, pulls while stepping and turning, then releases and stands.

takes.sourceDescription: A sits; B pulls up A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Rise with partner's help, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts seated, raises a hand, leans forward and stands, then takes steps away.

takes.sourceDescription: A sits, holds face in hands; B kneels, comforts A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Seated and comforted, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A remains seated with head bowed and hands near the face, then raises the head and one arm near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: B comforts A, puts one hand on A's shoulder (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Receive shoulder comfort, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A takes a few steps and stands with head and shoulders bowed, then lifts slightly near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A comforts B, puts both hands on B's shoulders (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Comfort partner at shoulders, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A raises both hands, leans forward and reaches out at shoulder height, then straightens and lowers the arms.

takes.sourceDescription: B comforts A, puts both hands on A's shoulders (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Receive two-handed comfort, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into standing, leans slightly and remains upright with arms low.

takes.sourceDescription: A comforts B, puts one hand on B's shoulder (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Comfort partner at shoulder, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A holds one hand raised and extended while standing and making small weight shifts.

takes.sourceDescription: hold hands, swing arms, walk (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Hold hands and walk, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A walks with an arm extended, swings it forward and back, and continues stepping through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A gives B a shoulder rub; B sits, A stands (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Give shoulder rub, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A stands leaning forward with both hands extended downward, making repeated small hand and arm movements.

takes.sourceDescription: A shelters B, a younger child, from harm (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Shelter a child, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into a wide stance, spreads the arms and turns with bent knees, then draws the arms down and returns upright.

takes.sourceDescription: B shelters A, a younger child, from harm (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Sheltered child, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts standing and shifts into a wide bent-knee stance, looking upward and lowering the body through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A stumbles into B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Stumble into partner, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts in a quick leaning step with hands raised, recovers balance and settles upright.

takes.sourceDescription: A passes soda to B; both drink (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pass soda and drink, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A raises a hand to the mouth, moves an arm outward, then lowers the arms and stands.

takes.sourceDescription: alternating squats (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Alternating squats, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts standing, performs two deep squats with pauses upright, then returns to standing.

takes.sourceDescription: alternating jumping jacks (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Alternating jumping jack, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts standing, jumps into a wide stance while raising both arms, then brings arms and feet back and stands.

takes.sourceDescription: synchronized jumping jacks (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Synchronized jumping jacks, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A repeats jumps into a wide stance with arms overhead, returning arms and legs between repetitions and ending upright.

takes.sourceDescription: rush up, arm wrestle (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Arm wrestle, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into a wide lunge, holds one forearm upright and presses or leans forward, then continues shifting in the stance.

takes.sourceDescription: A stares down B, leans with hands on high stool (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Stand and lean on stool, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A begins seated, rises into a wide stance and leans forward with hands down, remaining bent through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: B stares down A, leans with hands on high stool (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Seated stare-down, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A remains seated with hands near the lap, makes small head and torso shifts, and finishes seated.

takes.sourceDescription: violence - A picks up high stool, threatens to strike B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Raise stool in threat, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A rises from a seated position, widens the stance and raises both hands beside the head as if holding an object, then keeps the arms raised.

takes.sourceDescription: conversation - B pounds high stool, points at A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Seated conversation, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A remains seated, makes brief hand gestures near the chest and lap, and finishes seated.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; B catches keys thrown by A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Throw keys while walking, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A walks with small alternating steps and finishes still moving.
takes.reviewNote: Source identifies a key throw; the object and release are not discernible in the sheet.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; A catches keys thrown by B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Catch keys while walking, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A begins with hands together in front, lowers the arms and continues walking through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; B catches wallet thrown by A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Throw wallet while walking, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A continues alternating walking steps with arms near the body and ends mid-stride.
takes.reviewNote: Source identifies a wallet throw; the object and release are not discernible in the sheet.

takes.sourceDescription: walk; A catches wallet thrown by B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Catch wallet while walking, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts with both arms raised, brings the hands together in front while stepping, then lowers them and continues walking.
